subject.title: [Feature]: feat: trigger session-memory hook on /compact command

question: Should bundled session-memory archive on manual `/compact`, on all `session:compact:before` lifecycle events, or should memoryFlush/continuity remain the intended compaction-memory product path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent product contract affects manual versus automatic compaction, transcript retention, and overlap with memoryFlush/continuity work.

options.title: Use lifecycle archive
options.body: Wire session-memory to `session:compact:before` so both manual and automatic compaction can capture the pre-compaction transcript under one lifecycle contract.

options.title: Manual compact only
options.body: Add a `/compact`-only archive path if maintainers want user-invoked compaction to behave like `/new` and `/reset` without changing automatic compaction.

options.title: Keep memoryFlush path
options.body: Document memoryFlush/continuity as the intended preservation mechanism and leave session-memory scoped to reset/new events.

recommendation.title: Use lifecycle archive
recommendation.body: Wire session-memory to `session:compact:before` so both manual and automatic compaction can capture the pre-compaction transcript under one lifecycle contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the compaction lifecycle hook surface most directly involved in the product decision.
